title: The scarlet rehearsal
alt: A dancer stretches at a wooden barre as a pianist plays a grand piano behind her.
description: A scarlet rehearsal dress and warm window light connect two distinct figures in a working studio.
prompt: A candid fashion-editorial photograph inside a ballet rehearsal studio just after dark. An adult dancer in a deep scarlet skirt stretches at a wooden barre in the right foreground. In the left background, an older pianist in a cream shirt plays an open black grand piano. Their hands are engaged with their own objects. The piano lid is held open by its prop, and the glossy wooden floor catches warm pools of light from the studio windows. Frame both people, the piano and the dancer’s slippers in one balanced composition. No mirrors, text or other people.
